---
title: "Explanation"

---

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| **Status badge** | The outer ring records the statement's formalization and review; the centre records progress on its proof or disproof. See the [badge legend](/reviews/status-badge/index.qmd). |
| **Summary** | What is known and what remains unresolved. A proof attempt can still have gaps. |
| **Open count** | The number of recorded unresolved obligations, such as missing proof steps or checks. |
| **Topic tags** | The subjects and techniques the problem concerns. |
| **Model** | The setting in which the claim is made, such as `rom` (random oracle), `qrom` (quantum random oracle) or `ggm` (generic group). |
| **Form** | The kind of claim, such as a lower bound, tight bound, impossibility result or assumption. |
| **Category** | Distinguishes open research, solved results and test cases. |
| **Difficulty** | How far a solution is from existing techniques: `routine`, `adaptation`, `new-idea` or `barrier`. `(ai)` identifies an AI assessment. See the [difficulty legend](/reviews/status-badge/index.qmd#difficulty-legend). |
| **Organisation tags** | Affiliations of authors of cited sources. |
